monogr.title: Rabbi Yapheth ben Heli Bassorensis Karaïtæ in librum Psalmorum commentarii arabici e duplici codice mss. Bibliothecæ Regiæ Parisiensis

biblStruct.note: An edition and Latin translation of Yefet’s complete Judaeo-Arabic translation and commentary on the first two psalms, including his introduction to the book, based on two Mss. from the Bibliothèque nationale: MS: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France, héb. 286 (Bargès’ Ms. “A” [= “Codex K” on p. xxvi]) and MS: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France, héb. 290 (Bargès’ Ms. “B” [= “Codex O” on p. xxviii]). (Biblia Arabica)
